title: Fix Section List Command Filtering and Symbols
description: The section list command shows sections from all files instead of just the specified file. It also uses § (definition symbol) instead of # (section symbol). Child sections should display as #SECTION#CHILDSECTION#...
summary: Fixed section list command: (1) Fixed StreamFiles to handle compose/BUNDLE/file.ext scope by parsing bundle prefix + sub-path, and added single-file fast path. (2) Changed section symbol from § to # in all rendering. (3) Added hierarchical path to flattened sections so child sections display as #Parent#Child#GrandChild format.
